activation_conditions: Confirmed malicious session or token use affecting the named account
business_impact_ceiling: One identity; no known critical-service interruption
fallback_if_authority_unavailable: Escalate for break-glass, service, or safety-critical identities
evidence_to_preserve_first: Identity, OAuth, sign-in, and audit logs
reassessment_or_reversal_trigger: Validate clean access and dependent sessions within 30 minutes

activation_conditions: Confirmed malicious session with no critical integration dependency
fallback_if_authority_unavailable: Escalate when identity dependencies exceed the approved impact ceiling
evidence_to_preserve_first: Session, sign-in, token, and application-consent telemetry
notification_requirements: Incident Commander and affected user’s business owner

activation_conditions: Confirmed abuse involving executive identities or applications
business_impact_ceiling: Executive productivity interruption within the approved ceiling
evidence_to_preserve_first: OAuth grant, consent, sign-in, mailbox, and audit telemetry
notification_requirements: CISO, executive support, Legal, Privacy, and Service Desk
reassessment_or_reversal_trigger: Review impact and residual unauthorized access after containment

activation_conditions: Confirmed or imminent compromise beyond the initially affected identities
business_impact_ceiling: Organization-defined interruption to critical integrations and user sessions
fallback_if_authority_unavailable: Continue targeted containment, block confirmed infrastructure, and escalate
evidence_to_preserve_first: Token, sign-in, application-consent, and session telemetry
notification_requirements: Incident Commander, Legal, Privacy, Service Desk, and service owners
reassessment_or_reversal_trigger: Review business impact and malicious access after the first containment cycle

activation_conditions: Continued operation presents material harm that cannot be contained at a lower-impact tier
decision_authority: Designated business executive advised by the CISO
business_impact_ceiling: Explicitly accepted outage, customer, financial, and recovery consequences
fallback_if_authority_unavailable: Apply the highest authorized lower-impact containment and maintain escalation
evidence_to_preserve_first: System state, active sessions, logs, dependencies, and recovery checkpoints
notification_requirements: Executive Sponsor, Legal, Privacy, Communications, service owner, and continuity leadership
reassessment_or_reversal_trigger: Time-bound review and documented recovery authorization

activation_conditions: Validated facts trigger applicable legal, contractual, or notification obligations
decision_authority: Designated legal, privacy, and executive authority
business_impact_ceiling: Approved legal, customer, market, and trust consequences
approval_window: Driven by applicable obligations and counsel guidance
fallback_if_authority_unavailable: Preserve facts, draft communications, track deadlines, and escalate without speculative disclosure
evidence_to_preserve_first: Affected-data scope, timeline, access evidence, jurisdiction, and impacted parties
notification_requirements: Executive Sponsor, counsel, Privacy, Communications, insurer, and designated recipients
reassessment_or_reversal_trigger: Update notifications when material facts or affected populations change
